::: {.callout-note}
## Methods decisions

* Breath-by-breath time-series synchronised with cross-correlation for each interval.

* Local outliers removed with 30-sec rolling window.

* Smooth/binning method: **bin = 10** sec.

* 5-minute interval plus 60-sec recovery after end.

* Four participants (four of the six women) required shortening the strap. Visual clustering of these four participants justified omitting them from VE, but included for RR.

* Note: terminology for respiratory frequency/breathing rate is *inconsistent* throughout this document: **RR**, **BR**, or the manuscript version ***f*~R~** are used interchangeably.


:::

## MAE & MAPE

Obsolete, superseded by rmcorr and Bland-Altman below.

* `cv_between_devices` is the typical within-participant percentage disagreement between paired measurements.

* `cv_each_device` is the share attributable to either device, assuming both have equal and independent measurement error.

* `mean_bias` is the average percentage by which Parvo differs from Tymewear positive means Parvo is higher.

```{r}
#| label: MAE-MAPE

list(
    "RR" = tar_read(error_summary_RR),
    "VE" = tar_read(error_summary_VE),
    "VE (ids excluded)" = tar_read(error_summary_VE_excl)
) |>
    list_rbind(names_to = "measure") |>
    knitr::kable(digits = 1)
```

## Sensitivity analysis for smoothing methods

* Four participants excluded for VE only.

* BxB (width = 1) resulting in misaligned breaths, overestimates error.

* bin = 10 sec chosen as a compromise.

```{r}
#| label: smooth-sensitivity-plot
#| code-summary: "Show figure code"
#| fig-asp: 1

exclude_ids <- c("TW04", "TW05", "BP12", "BP19")

df <- readRDS("results.rds") |>
    select(id, stage, smooth, time, br, ve, RR, VE)

df_list <- group_split(df, smooth)

yvars <- c("VE", "RR")

agree_df <- lapply(yvars, \(yvar) {
    lapply(df_list, \(.df) {
        if(yvar == "VE") .df <- filter_out(.df, id %in% exclude_ids)

        agree_table <- SimplyAgree::agreement_limit(
            .df,
            x = ifelse(yvar == "RR", "br", "ve"),
            y = ifelse(yvar == "RR", "RR", "VE"),
            id = "id",
            data_type = "nest",
            loa_calc = "blandaltman"
        )
        
        model <- rmcorr::rmcorr(
            participant = "id",
            measure1 = ifelse(yvar == "RR", "br", "ve"),
            measure2 = ifelse(yvar == "RR", "RR", "VE"),
            dataset = .df
        )
    
        tibble(
            measure = yvar,
            smooth = .df$smooth[1L],
            bias = agree_table$loa$bias,
            loa.lower = agree_table$loa$lower_loa,
            loa.upper = agree_table$loa$upper_loa,
            r = model$r,
            r.lower = model$CI[1],
            r.upper = model$CI[2],
        )
    }) |> 
        list_rbind()
}) |>
    list_rbind() |>
    mutate(
        measure = factor(
            measure,
            levels = yvars,
            labels = c("Ventilation (L/min)", "respiratory frequency (breaths/min)")
        ),
        smooth = factor(
            smooth,
            levels = rev(levels(df$smooth))
        ),
    )

rmplot <- ggplot(agree_df, aes(x = smooth, colour = measure)) +
    labs(
        subtitle = "Effect on repeated measures correlation",
        x = NULL
    ) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line()) +
    scale_colour_discrete(name = NULL) +
    coord_flip(ylim = c(NA, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        name = "rmcorr [95% CI]",
        expand = expansion(c(0.03, 0))
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(4.5, 8.5), linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = r.lower, ymax = r.upper), width = 0.3) +
    geom_point(aes(y = r), fill = "white", shape = 21, stroke = 1)

baplot <- ggplot(agree_df, aes(x = smooth, colour = measure)) +
    labs(
        subtitle = "Effect on Bland-Altman Mean Bias ± Limits of Agreement",
        x = NULL
    ) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line()) +
    scale_colour_discrete(name = NULL) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(
        name = "Mean Bias [95% LoA]",
        expand = expansion(c(0.03, 0))
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(4.5, 8.5), linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = loa.lower, ymax = loa.upper), width = 0.3) +
    geom_point(aes(y = bias), fill = "white", shape = 21, stroke = 1)

ggarrange(
    rmplot,
    baplot,
    nrow = 2,
    common.legend = TRUE
) |>
    annotate_figure(
        top = text_grob(
            paste(
                "Sensitivity Analysis for Smooth Levels",
                "width = n breaths; span & bin = n seconds",
                sep = "\n"
            ),
            size = 17,
            face = "bold"
        )
    )
```

### VE

* VE is fit with proportional bias, so the untransformed LoA table has one row
per evaluation point — bias and limits at the minimum, mean, and maximum of
the mean of the two devices

* The log-ratio fit below keeps a single flat bias.

```{r}

tar_read(agree_log_fit_VE)
```

## Equivalence Testing — Body Position

* racing versus upright position, with the device effect and its interaction
retained in the model.

* Four participants excluded for VE only.

### RR

```{r}
#| label: equivalence-position-RR

## mixed model of log RR
summary(tar_read(eq_pos_fit_RR_pos)$model)

## racing vs upright mean log-ratio, TOST against ±3%
tar_read(eq_pos_fit_RR_pos)$eq
```


### VE

```{r}
#| label: equivalence-position-VE

## mixed model of log VE
summary(tar_read(eq_pos_fit_VE_pos)$model)

## racing vs upright mean log-ratio, TOST against ±3%
tar_read(eq_pos_fit_VE_pos)$eq
```

```{r}
#| label: equivalence-plot
#| fig-asp: 0.667

eq_RR <- tar_read(eq_fit_RR)$eq
eq_VE <- tar_read(eq_fit_VE_excl)$eq
eq_RR_pos <- tar_read(eq_pos_fit_RR_pos)$eq
eq_VE_pos <- tar_read(eq_pos_fit_VE_pos)$eq

## estimates, CIs and point styling for device and body-position equivalence
obs_df <- bind_rows(eq_RR, eq_VE, eq_RR_pos, eq_VE_pos) |>
    mutate(
        across(c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high), \(.x) .x * 100),
        y = c(3, 2.5, 1, 0.5),
        label = rep(
            c("bold(italic('f')['R'])", "bold(dot(V)['E'])"),
            2
        ),
        shape = c(19, 19, 17, 17),
        size = c(4, 4, 4.5, 4.5),
        hjust = c(0.8, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
    )

ggplot(obs_df, aes(x = estimate, y = y)) +
    theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 2, 5, unit = "mm"),
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-10, 30), ylim = c(0, 4.25)) +
    scale_x_continuous(
        name = "Log Symmetric Differences (%)",
        breaks = c(-10, -3, 3, seq(0, 30, 10)),
        expand = expansion(0),
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(0)) +
    annotate(
        "rect",
        xmin = -3,
        xmax = 3,
        ymin = -Inf,
        ymax = Inf,
        fill = "#42B540FF",
        alpha = 0.5,
    ) +
    geom_vline(
        xintercept = c(-3, 0, 3),
        linetype = c("dashed", "solid", "dashed")
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
        aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high),
        linewidth = 1,
        width = 0.15
    ) +
    geom_point(shape = obs_df$shape, size = obs_df$size) +
    geom_text(
        aes(label = label, hjust = hjust),
        vjust = -1,
        size = 7,
        parse = TRUE
    ) +
    annotate(
        "segment",
        x = -9,
        xend = 29,
        y = c(4, 2),
        linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    annotate(
        "label",
        x = 10,
        y = c(4, 2),
        size = 7,
        label = c(
            "Equivalence between devices",
            "Equivalence for effect of cycling position"
        ),
    )
```
